constraint_results.judge_reason: The implementation includes a recursive _redact helper function that processes nested dicts at any depth, redacting sensitive keys and incrementing count. At the end, it calls auditing.write_event('redaction.applied', keys_redacted=count) with the total count of all redacted keys (both top-level and nested).
